title: Run DeepSeek-R1 Locally on Your PC with KTransformers (CPU-GPU Hybrid)
description:
KTransformers is an open-source framework that lets you run and fine-tune massive AI models like DeepSeek-R1 and Qwen3 on consumer hardware. It splits the work across your CPU and GPU, so you don't need a server farm. Install with pip and run one command.
